verdict.rationale: Supabase says every project is a full Postgres database that is "100% portable". Self-hosting via Docker Compose gives a documented place to land, and S3-compatible Storage plus Logs export point to open, standard access paths. But the evidence documents no export procedure (such as a full database dump) covering the database, auth users and stored files together, so 'export everything and leave' is implied rather than shown. Missing for 10: a documented full-project export workflow (dump command or downloadable backups), explicit coverage of auth and storage data in export, and independent or hands-on corroboration of a successful migration off the platform.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
